from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    line_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if fill not in row]
    line_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] != fill for r in range(h))]
    nonfill = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row if v != fill)
    neutral = nonfill.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # Plain outer lattice lines carry only the neutral color; retain marker-bearing lines.
    line_rows = [r for r in line_rows if any(grid[r][c] != neutral for c in line_cols)]
    line_cols = [c for c in line_cols if any(grid[r][c] != neutral for r in line_rows)]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in zip(line_rows, line_rows[1:]):
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in zip(line_cols, line_cols[1:]):
            vals = (grid[r0][c0], grid[r0][c1], grid[r1][c0], grid[r1][c1])
            row.append(vals[0] if vals.count(vals[0]) == 4 and vals[0] != neutral else fill)
        out.append(row)
    return out

def _regular_missing_rows(grid, value, axis):
    n = len(grid) if axis == 0 else len(grid[0])
    indices = [i for i in range(n) if all((grid[i][j] != value if axis == 0 else grid[j][i] != value) for j in range(len(grid[0]) if axis == 0 else len(grid)))]
    if len(indices) < 2:
        return None
    gaps = [b-a for a,b in zip(indices, indices[1:])]
    if len(set(gaps)) != 1:
        return None
    return indices

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    candidates = []
    for value in set(v for row in grid for v in row):
        rows = _regular_missing_rows(grid, value, 0)

    while out and all(v == fill for v in out[0]): out.pop(0)

    if out:
        while out[0] and all(row[0] == fill for row in out):
            for row in out: row.pop(0)
        while out[0] and all(row[-1] == fill for row in out):

'''
